sourceKind: Five operator raw tmux capture-pane -p -N -T captures. All raw rows retain exact lengths, padding, row positions and final LF; cwd and challenge prompts/replies are equal-length synthetic replacements. Cursor36/2, modes and server/pane/process identity are reconstructed metadata, not attested by raw files. Draft and repeated guard are hypothetical reconstructions (composer36, warning-only footer39, cursorX86). Operator reports exactly one guarded Enter and same process after explicit reattach; coder did not reproduce live execution. Partial response row26 is the literal six-character prefix plus raw padding; no completion, so it is deliberately unsupported.
